items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Fiedler? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. So, he ain't moving me at all.

ctx.x: Like this man up here in Boston, up here, with all those musicians up there, you don't have nothing black up there, around up there.
Yeah. So, he ain't moving me at all. I'm talking about Lawrence Welk.
